verdict.rationale: OpenTofu natively acts on many resources at once. It builds a resource graph and parallelizes creation and modification of non-dependent resources. Destroy mode plans removal of all remote objects. `for_each` generates provider configurations in bulk, and a single variable change can update all modules. A community user confirms the `for_each` support for `import` blocks enables bulk imports, and `-exclude` lets users scope these mass operations. missing for 10: explicit docs for resource-level `for_each`/`count` bulk patterns, hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk runs beyond the import comment.
